counties.long: Vice-Dale County (Vice City, Vice Beach and around)

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Ammu-Nation Gun Stores Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 21, 2026 via ?p=371141. 24 stores, names, county, map icon type (Limited, Standard, Hunting, Expanded; Expanded has LMG, sniper, grenade and rocket launchers). Each sells a unique weapon variant. Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Mod Shops Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 21, 2026 via ?p=371137. 14 shops, county, speciality; Rideout Customs and One-Eyed Willie's Ultimate Edition only (matches editionItems.json from Rockstar). Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Pay 'n' Spray Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 21, 2026 via ?p=371138. 19 locations, county and area labels. Repair + respray, police lose the car. Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Car Washes Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 21, 2026 via ?p=371140. 6 car washes, all in Vice City; optional; repairing also cleans the car. Park N Glow has no area label. Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Clothing Stores Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 24, 2026 (modified Nov 20; ?p=371144). 67 stores in five types (17 Casual & Street, 11 Sportswear, 10 Formal, 24 Souvenir & Swimwear, 5 Thrift), county headings, area where given ("Ocean Beach 1-4" shown as Ocean Beach). Same brand usually sells the same clothes; most have a changing room; 15 saved outfits; clothes wait in the home wardrobe and can be kept in the car trunk; some Ammu-Nations and mod shops sell clothes; shoes are a separate store type (17 footwear stores). Stock 305 Ultimate Edition only (matches editionItems.json from Rockstar). Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Convenience Stores Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 24, 2026 (modified Nov 18). 72 stores (10 Mariana, 37 Vice-Dale, 5 Leonard, 14 Kelly, 6 Lummox); area taken from the "Name – Area" part of the name (Balerso typo fixed to Balsero). Sell Zombix, pet food for animals you meet and groceries for the fridge at home. Map filter Food & Drink > Convenience Stores. Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Footwear Stores Locations (Shoe Shops)
sources.note: Read Nov 24, 2026 via ?p=371145 (published Nov 18). 17 stores (2 Mariana, 12 Vice-Dale, 2 Leonard, 1 Kelly); brand and area from the "Brand – Area" names (numbers after repeated areas dropped). Orange shoe icon; many clothing stores also sell shoes. Map filter Style > Footwear. Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Hair & Beauty Salon Locations (Change Hairstyle)
sources.note: Read Nov 24, 2026 via ?p=371146 (published Nov 18). 18 salons (3 Mariana, 12 Vice-Dale, 1 Leonard, 2 Kelly) with type label Unisex / Barber / Beauty Salon; no areas. Standard hairstyles everywhere, some salons have signature styles; Lucia can change nails and makeup at beauty salons. Orange scissors icon. Sara's Unisex Salon Ultimate Edition only (matches editionItems.json from Rockstar). Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Tattoo Studios Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 24, 2026 via ?p=371147 (published Nov 18). 11 studios (1 Mariana, 8 Vice-Dale, 2 Kelly) with style label; no areas. Each studio has its own designs; orange heart icon; map filter Style > Tattoos. Electric Fang Ultimate Edition only (matches editionItems.json). Spelling "Twa Ponya" as on PowerPyx (route WAiNK row writes TWA). Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Gas Stations Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 24, 2026 via ?p=371139 (published Nov 18). 57 stations (7 Mariana, 26 Vice-Dale, 12 Kelly, 6 Leonard, 6 Lummox); brand and area from names. Every vehicle uses fuel; gauge above the minimap, yellow at low fuel with nearby stations marked; an empty tank stops the vehicle. Blue petrol icon; map filter Vehicles > Gas Stations. Ron Gas Balsero is listed twice. "West Kallaga" typo written as Kalaga, as everywhere else. Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Electronics Stores Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 24, 2026 via ?p=371148 (published/modified Nov 18). 15 stores (13 Vice-Dale, 1 Leonard, 1 Kelly), county headings only; area from the two "Tech Point – Area" names. Sell accessories, phone cases to customize the phone and headphones you can wear. Orange headphone icon; map filter Style > Electronics with a found counter. Trusted source.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Train Stations Locations
sources.note: Read Nov 24, 2026 via ?p=371142 (published/modified Nov 18). 25 stations (2 Mariana, 17 Vice-Dale, 1 Leonard, 3 Kelly, 2 Lummox), county headings only; Central Line listed twice (#10, #15). Ride the train around the map like a bus; you wait for the train to arrive. Blue train icon; map filter Vehicles > Train Stations with a found counter. Trusted source.
